admission.justification: Two routing designs were weighed and the choice binds every family record.

alternatives.option: Several local routes per family, each close to the code it covers
alternatives.reason: Local routes make every place a family's code lives easy to find.

alternatives.option: One owning route containing every realization
alternatives.reason: Cross-tree families collapse to the repository root and describe nothing locally.
alternatives.reconsider_when: Families rarely span subtrees in practice.

consequences: Coverage and non-empty checks run per family route set.
context: Families span several subtrees; they need homes that stay accurate.
